AMP GHFully Modular Power Supply | 850Introducing the Phanteks AMP GH Series, these units revolutionize cable management with sleek, individually textured cables for a pristine setup. Enhanced with a 120 mm Hydraulic Dynamic Bearing Fan, they deliver temperature-controlled operation in Hybrid Fanless mode, ensuring virtually silent performance.
With the latest PCIe Gen 5.1 GPU cable technology, the 12V-2×6 connector delivers up to 450W of power via a single cable. Engineered to meet ATX 3.1 specifications, the Phanteks AMP GH represents a superior and cost-effective choice for high-performance builds.

textSegments: Introducing the Phanteks AMP GH Series, these units revolutionize cable management with sleek, individually textured cables for a pristine setup. Enhanced with a 120 mm Hydraulic Dynamic Bearing Fan, they deliver temperature-controlled operation in Hybrid Fanless mode, ensuring virtually silent performance.

With the latest PCIe Gen 5.1 GPU cable technology, the 12V-2×6 connector delivers up to 450W of power via a single cable. Engineered to meet ATX 3.1 specifications, the Phanteks AMP GH represents a superior and cost-effective choice for high-performance builds.
Built to ATX 3.1 Specifications, ready to handle new and upcoming CPU and GPU hardware requirements.
Fully Modular Design, individually textured cables for easy installation and reduced clutter.
Latest PCIe Gen5.1 GPU Connector, 12V-2×6 connector providing up to 450W of power through a single cable.
Made to fit in most standard cases, so you can build with confidence and ease.
Ultra-high power density with a small footprint of only 140mm depth.
Reduces current transmission resistance for increased efficiency.
The hydraulic dynamic bearing (HDB) improves the lubrication of the bearing for increased stability and longevity.
The back panel and PCB are connected by a copper plate to improve output power quality.
Multiple 6-Pin and 8-Pin output connectors support all multi GPU platforms.
Advanced fan control for smart thermal management.
Operates completely fanless under 30% load for silent performance.
Ideal for ultra-quiet system builds and noise-sensitive environments.
Balances cooling efficiency with acoustic optimization.
Where do I find the product manual?
Where do I find the product manual?

Most products have their product manual in the accessory box or directly printed on the packaging if the installation only contains a few steps. For the latest version, we always recommend checking the online manual, which can be found under the support section of the product page.
How do I know my GPU will fit?
How do I know my GPU will fit?

Because there are many different GPU sizes, it is always recommended to check the GPU clearance beforehand. If the length of the GPU fits within the clearance numbers, the GPU should fit neatly. This information can be found within the ‘Specifications’ section on the product page.
What can I find on the Phanteks website?
What can I find on the Phanteks website?
The Phanteks website provides product information, specifications, features, compatibility information, manuals, downloads, and other resources for Phanteks products.

Can I purchase Phanteks products directly from the website?

The Phanteks website is designed to provide product information and support. Products are available through authorized retailers and distributors. If you live within the USA, please visit our official online store:
Where can I find information about a specific Phanteks product?
Where can I find information about a specific Phanteks product?
Visit the product page for the product you are interested in. Product pages contain available specifications, features, compatibility information, downloads, and other relevant product details.
Where can I find compatibility information?
Where can I find compatibility information?
Compatibility information is provided on the corresponding product page where available. If you cannot find the information you need, contact our support team.
How can I find the dimensions of a product?
How can I find the dimensions of a product?
Product dimensions and other physical specifications can be found on the individual product page under the ‘Specifications’ section.
Where can I find information about discontinued products?
Where can I find information about discontinued products?

Information for discontinued products, also called ‘End of Life’ EoL for short, may remain available on the Phanteks website for reference. Availability of documentation and support may vary by product.
